```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(TFBlearner)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ggplot2)
source("utils.R")

valChrs <- c("chr2", "chr4", "chr9")
```

# Load annot data

```{r, import data}
dhsCoords <- fread("../../data/annotation/dhs.bed", 
                   col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), 
                   select=1:3)
combinations <- fread("../../data/common/04_train_test_combinations.tsv")
combinations[,comb:=paste(TF, CellularContext, sep="_")]
testCombinations <- subset(combinations, set=="testData")
trainCombinations <- subset(combinations, set=="trainData")

dhsCoordsDt <- as.data.table(dhsCoords)
dhsCoordsDt <- subset(dhsCoordsDt, chr %in% valChrs)
dhsCoordsSub <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(dhsCoordsDt))
```

```{r, full ChIP-Matrix DHS}
mae <- readRDS("../../data/TFBlearner/objects/additional_support_object/01_maeAddSupport.rds")

chIpSubRanges <- subsetByOverlaps(rowRanges(mae[["ChIP"]]), dhsCoordsSub, type="equal")
chIPSe <- mae[["ChIP"]][overlapsAny(rowRanges(mae[["ChIP"]]),
                                    chIpSubRanges, type="equal"),]
whichCol <- which(!(chIPSe[["combination"]] %in%
                  subset(sampleMap(mae), get(TFBlearner:::ISTESTCOL) & 
                                         assay==TFBlearner:::CHIPEXP)$colname))

chIPMat <- TFBlearner:::.convertToMatrix(assays(chIPSe)$peaks[,whichCol])
```

## DHS

```{r, get labels dhs}
labels.dhs <- list()
for(comb in unique(testCombinations$comb)){
  
  # high-confidence labels -----------------------------------------------------
  hc.Labels <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                      paste0("filtered_merged_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                      col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"))
  hc.Labels$comb <- comb
  hc.anyOv <- genomicRangesMapping(dhsCoordsSub, 
                                   hc.Labels, 
                                   byCols="comb")
  
  hc.Labels[,center:=floor((end-start)/2)+start]
  hc.Labels[,start:=center-15]
  hc.Labels[,end:=center+15]
  hc.peakOv <- genomicRangesMapping(dhsCoordsSub, 
                                    hc.Labels, 
                                    byCols="comb")
  
  # non-cons peak labels -------------------------------------------------------
  
  nc.Labels <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                     paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                     col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"))
  nc.Labels$comb <- comb
  nc.anyOv <- genomicRangesMapping(dhsCoordsSub, 
                                   nc.Labels, 
                                   byCols="comb")
  
  nc.Labels[,center:=floor((end-start)/2)+start]
  nc.Labels[,start:=center-15]
  nc.Labels[,end:=center+15]
  nc.peakOv <- genomicRangesMapping(dhsCoordsSub, 
                                    nc.Labels, 
                                    byCols="comb")
  
  # merge labels ---------------------------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt <- data.table(hc.peak.ov=hc.peakOv[,1,drop=TRUE],
                        hc.any.ov=hc.anyOv[,1,drop=TRUE], 
                        nc.peak.ov=nc.peakOv[,1,drop=TRUE], 
                        nc.any.ov=nc.anyOv[,1,drop=TRUE])
  labelDt[,dhs_id:=1:.N]
  
  # add if site contains motif -------------------------------------------------
  
  tf <- unlist(tstrsplit(comb, split="_", keep=1))
  mm <- fread(file.path("../../data/motifs/motif_matches_dhs/",
              paste0(tf, ".bed")), 
              col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)
  mm <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(mm))
  labelDt$ov.motif <- overlapsAny(dhsCoordsSub, mm)

  # if any peak in training data -----------------------------------------------
  trainCombs <- subset(trainCombinations, TF==tf)$comb
  trainPeaks <- lapply(trainCombs, function(comb){
                       trainPeaks <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                                           paste0("filtered_merged_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                                           col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)  
  })
  trainPeaks <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(rbindlist(trainPeaks)))
  labelDt$ov.trainPeak <- overlapsAny(dhsCoordsSub, trainPeaks)
  
  # add if is in all train -----------------------------------------------------
  trainCombs <- subset(trainCombinations, TF==tf)$comb
  ovTrainPeaks <- lapply(trainCombs, function(comb){
                       trainPeaks <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                                           paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                                           col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)
                       trainPeaks <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(trainPeaks))
                       oc <- overlapsAny(dhsCoordsSub, trainPeaks)
                       oc})
  nCountOv <- Reduce("cbind", ovTrainPeaks[-1], ovTrainPeaks[[1]])
  labelDt$ov.all.trainPeak <- fifelse(rowSums(nCountOv)==length(trainCombs), TRUE, FALSE)
  
  # add if is in at least two train --------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt$ov.2.trainPeak <- fifelse(rowSums(nCountOv)>=2, TRUE, FALSE)
  
  # add crowdedness information ------------------------------------------------
  
  chippedTfs <- unlist(tstrsplit(colnames(chIPMat), split="_", keep=2))
  cScore <- TFBlearner:::.getCrowdedness(chIPMat[,chippedTfs!=tf])
  cScore <- cScore[,1,drop=TRUE]
  siteWidth <- width(chIpSubRanges)
  totTFs <- length(unique(setdiff(chippedTfs, tf)))
  cScore <- 200*(cScore/totTFs)/pmax(100L, siteWidth)
  
  q.99.cScore <- quantile(cScore, 0.99)
  top.cScore <- which(cScore>q.99.cScore)
  labelDt[,top.cScore:=fifelse(dhs_id %in% top.cScore, TRUE, FALSE)]
  
  # add coordinates and save ---------------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt <- cbind(labelDt, as.data.table(dhsCoordsSub))
  labels.dhs[[comb]] <- labelDt
}

labels.dhs <- rbindlist(labels.dhs, idcol="comb")
labels.dhs[,c("tf", "context"):=tstrsplit(comb, split="_")]

saveRDS(labels.dhs, "labels.dhs.rds")
```

## Full genome

```{r, binning}
# TODO: Remove blacklisted regions !!!
blListRegions <- fread("../../data/annotation/blacklist.bed", 
                       col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"))
blListRegions <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(blListRegions))

chrSizes <- fread("../../data/annotation/reChr.sizes", 
                  col.names=c("chr", "length"))
chrSizes <- subset(chrSizes, chr %in% valChrs)

binDts <- lapply(split(chrSizes, by="chr"), function(chrSizeDt){
  binDt <- data.table(start=seq(from=0, to=chrSizeDt$length, by=200))
  binDt[,end:=start+199]
  binDt$chr <- chrSizeDt$chr[[1]]
  binDt
})
binDt <- rbindlist(binDts)
binRanges <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(binDt))
binRanges <- subsetByOverlaps(binRanges, blListRegions, invert=TRUE)
write.table(as.data.table(binRanges), "fullChrBinRanges.bed", 
            sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r, compute crowdedness}
nonConsPeakFiles <- list.files("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks", 
                               pattern="filtered_nonCons_peaks_*", 
                               full.names=TRUE)
binCounts <- list()
for(tf in unique(trainCombinations$TF)){
  
  allCombs <- subset(combinations, TF==tf)$comb
  nonConsPeakFiles <- file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks", 
                                paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", 
                                       allCombs, ".bed"))
  peakRanges <- lapply(nonConsPeakFiles, fread)
  peakRanges <- rbindlist(peakRanges)
  colnames(peakRanges) <- c("chr", "start", "end")
  peakRanges <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(peakRanges))
  binCounts[[tf]] <- matrix(overlapsAny(binRanges, peakRanges), ncol=1)
}
binCounts <- Reduce("cbind", binCounts[-1], binCounts[[1]]) 
colnames(binCounts) <- unique(trainCombinations$TF)
saveRDS(binCounts, "fullChrBinOvs.rds")
```

```{r, get labels full chromosomes}
labels.fullChr <- list()
for(comb in unique(testCombinations$comb)){
  
  # high-confidence labels -----------------------------------------------------
  hc.Labels <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                      paste0("filtered_merged_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                      col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"))
  hc.Labels$comb <- comb
  hc.anyOv <- genomicRangesMapping(binRanges, 
                                   hc.Labels, 
                                   byCols="comb")
  
  hc.Labels[,center:=floor((end-start)/2)+start]
  hc.Labels[,start:=center-15]
  hc.Labels[,end:=center+15]
  hc.peakOv <- genomicRangesMapping(binRanges, 
                                    hc.Labels, 
                                    byCols="comb")
  
  # non-cons peak labels -------------------------------------------------------
  
  nc.Labels <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                     paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                     col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"))
  nc.Labels$comb <- comb
  nc.anyOv <- genomicRangesMapping(binRanges, 
                                   nc.Labels, 
                                   byCols="comb")
  
  nc.Labels[,center:=floor((end-start)/2)+start]
  nc.Labels[,start:=center-15]
  nc.Labels[,end:=center+15]
  nc.peakOv <- genomicRangesMapping(binRanges, 
                                    nc.Labels, 
                                    byCols="comb")
  
  # merge labels ---------------------------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt <- data.table(hc.peak.ov=hc.peakOv[,1,drop=TRUE],
                        hc.any.ov=hc.anyOv[,1,drop=TRUE], 
                        nc.peak.ov=nc.peakOv[,1,drop=TRUE], 
                        nc.any.ov=nc.anyOv[,1,drop=TRUE])
  labelDt[,bin_id:=1:.N]
  
  # add if site contains motif -------------------------------------------------
  
  tf <- unlist(tstrsplit(comb, split="_", keep=1))
  mm <- fread(file.path("../../data/motifs/motif_matches_genome/",
              paste0(tf, ".bed")), 
              col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)
  mm <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(mm))
  labelDt$ov.motif <- overlapsAny(binRanges, mm)

  # if any peak in training data -----------------------------------------------
  
  trainCombs <- subset(trainCombinations, TF==tf)$comb
  trainPeaks <- lapply(trainCombs, function(comb){
                       trainPeaks <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                                           paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                                           col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)  
  })
  trainPeaks <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(rbindlist(trainPeaks)))
  labelDt$ov.trainPeak <- overlapsAny(binRanges, trainPeaks)
  
  # add if is in all train -----------------------------------------------------
  
  trainCombs <- subset(trainCombinations, TF==tf)$comb
  ovTrainPeaks <- lapply(trainCombs, function(comb){
                       trainPeaks <- fread(file.path("../../data/common/02_merged_chip_peaks",
                                           paste0("filtered_nonCons_peaks_", comb, ".bed")), 
                                           col.names=c("chr", "start", "end"), select=1:3)
                       trainPeaks <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(as.data.frame(trainPeaks))
                       oc <- overlapsAny(binRanges, trainPeaks)
                       oc})
  nCountOv <- Reduce("cbind", ovTrainPeaks[-1], ovTrainPeaks[[1]])

  labelDt$ov.all.trainPeak <- fifelse(rowSums(nCountOv)==length(trainCombs), TRUE, FALSE)
  
  # add if is in at least two train --------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt$ov.2.trainPeak <- fifelse(rowSums(nCountOv)>=2, TRUE, FALSE)
  
  # add if top crowed peak -----------------------------------------------------
  
  binSubCounts <- binCounts[,colnames(binCounts)!=tf]
  colnames(binSubCounts) <- paste("any", colnames(binSubCounts), sep="_")
  cScore <- TFBlearner:::.getCrowdedness(binSubCounts)
  cScore <- cScore[,1,drop=TRUE]
  q.99.cScore <- quantile(cScore, 0.99)
  top.cScore <- which(cScore>q.99.cScore)
  labelDt[,top.cScore:=fifelse(bin_id %in% top.cScore, TRUE, FALSE)]
  
  # add bin coordinates --------------------------------------------------------
  
  labelDt <- cbind(labelDt, as.data.table(binRanges))
  labels.fullChr[[comb]] <- labelDt
}
labels.fullChr <- rbindlist(labels.fullChr, idcol="comb")
labels.fullChr[,c("tf", "context"):=tstrsplit(comb, split="_")]

saveRDS(labels.fullChr, "labels.fullChr.rds")
```
